members.basePowerCallback: Sets the move's base power each time it's used. Return the base power, or false or null to fail.
members.beforeMoveCallback: Runs before the user uses the move. Return true to stop it.
members.beforeTurnCallback: Runs at the start of the turn the move was chosen, before anyone acts (Focus Punch, Counter).
members.damageCallback: Sets fixed damage instead of the damage formula (Seismic Toss). Return the damage, or false to fail.
members.priorityChargeCallback: Runs at the start of the turn, before anyone moves, for moves that charge up first (Focus Punch, Shell Trap).
members.durationCallback: Sets how many turns the condition lasts when it starts. Return the number of turns.
members.MoveEventMethods.onHit: Runs when the move hits a target. Return false to make it fail.
members.HitEffect.onHit: Runs when this secondary or self effect applies.
members.AbilityEventMethods.onStart: Runs when the ability activates: when the Pokémon switches in, or when it gains the ability.
members.AbilityEventMethods.onEnd: Runs when the ability stops working: the Pokémon switches out, faints or loses the ability.
members.AbilityEventMethods.onPreStart: Runs before the ability's onStart, when the Pokémon switches in.
members.AbilityEventMethods.onCheckShow: Runs when the game decides whether to reveal the ability (Natural Cure).
members.Condition.onStart: Runs when the condition starts. Return false to make it fail.
members.Condition.onRestart: Runs when the condition is applied again while it's active. Return false to make that fail.
members.Condition.onCopy: Runs when the condition is copied to another Pokémon (Baton Pass).
members.onSideStart: Runs when this side condition starts on a side.
members.onSideRestart: Runs when this side condition is applied again while it's active.
members.onSideResidual: Runs at the end of each turn for the side with this condition.
members.onSideEnd: Runs when this side condition ends.
members.onFieldStart: Runs when this field condition (weather, terrain, Trick Room, …) starts.
members.onFieldRestart: Runs when this field condition is applied again while it's active.
members.onFieldResidual: Runs at the end of each turn while this field condition is active.
members.onFieldEnd: Runs when this field condition ends.

prefixes.Ally: For the holder and its allies
prefixes.Source: When the holder is the source (usually the attacker)

ordering.Priority: Where `{handler}` runs among handlers for the same event: higher runs first (default 0).
ordering.Order: Where `{handler}` runs among handlers for the same event: lower runs first, and handlers with no order run last.
ordering.SubOrder: Tie-break for `{handler}` after order, priority and speed: lower runs first.

events.Accuracy: Changes a move's final accuracy against the Pokémon. Return the new accuracy, or true to always hit.
events.AfterBoost: Runs after the Pokémon's stat stages change.
events.AfterEachBoost: Runs after each change to the Pokémon's stat stages (Defiant).
events.AfterHit: Runs after a move hits the Pokémon and its effects are done.
events.AfterMega: Runs after the Pokémon Mega Evolves.
events.AfterMove: Runs after the Pokémon finishes using a move, whether or not it hit.
events.AfterMoveSecondary: Runs for the target after a move hits it and its secondary effects apply. Sheer Force skips it.
events.AfterMoveSecondarySelf: Runs for the user after its move hits and its secondary effects apply. Sheer Force skips it.
events.AfterMoveSelf: Runs after the Pokémon uses a move (generation 1 and 2 mechanics only).
events.AfterSetStatus: Runs after a major status (burn, paralysis, sleep, …) is set on the Pokémon.
events.AfterSubDamage: Runs after a move hits the Pokémon's substitute instead of the Pokémon.
events.AfterSwitchInSelf: Runs after the Pokémon switches in (generation 1 and 2 mechanics only).
events.AfterTakeItem: Runs after the Pokémon's item is taken or knocked off.
events.AfterUseItem: Runs after the Pokémon uses its item.
events.Attract: Runs when the Pokémon becomes infatuated.
events.BasePower: Changes a move's base power. Return the new value (usually with this.chainModify), or nothing to keep it.
events.BeforeFaint: Runs just before the Pokémon faints.
events.BeforeMove: Runs before the Pokémon uses a move. Return false to stop it (sleep, paralysis and flinching use this).
events.BeforeSwitchIn: Runs before the Pokémon switches in.
events.BeforeSwitchOut: Runs before the Pokémon switches out.
events.BeforeTurn: Runs at the start of each turn, before anyone acts.
events.ChangeBoost: Changes stat stage changes before they apply to the Pokémon (Simple, Contrary): edit the boost table.
events.ChargeMove: Runs when the Pokémon starts charging a two-turn move. Return false to skip the charging turn.
events.CriticalHit: Decides whether a move can land a critical hit on the Pokémon. Return false, or set it to false, to prevent it.
events.Damage: Runs before damage from any source is dealt to the Pokémon. Return a new amount, or false to prevent it.
events.DamagingHit: Runs after the Pokémon is hit by a damaging move.
events.DeductPP: Changes how much PP the Pokémon's move uses. Return the extra PP to deduct.
events.DisableMove: Runs when the Pokémon's moves are offered, so it can disable some with pokemon.disableMove().
events.DragOut: Runs when the Pokémon is about to be forced out (Roar, Dragon Tail). Return null to prevent it.
events.EatItem: Runs after the Pokémon eats a berry.
events.Effectiveness: Changes a move's effectiveness against one of the Pokémon's types. Return the new value (1 super effective, 0 neutral, -1 resisted).
events.EmergencyExit: Runs when damage drops the Pokémon to half its HP or less.
events.EntryHazard: Runs when the Pokémon switches in, at the point entry hazards apply.
events.Flinch: Runs when the Pokémon flinches. Return false, or set it to false, to prevent flinching.
events.FractionalPriority: Moves the Pokémon earlier or later within its priority bracket. Return a fraction such as 0.1 or -0.1, or set it to one.
events.Hit: Runs when a move hits the Pokémon. Return false to make the move fail.
events.HitField: Runs when the move hits the field. Return false to make it fail.
events.HitSide: Runs when the move hits a side. Return false to make it fail.
events.Immunity: Decides the Pokémon's immunity to a type or to weather damage ('sandstorm', 'hail', 'powder'). Return false for immune.
events.Invulnerability: Decides whether a move can hit the Pokémon while it's semi-invulnerable (Fly, Dig). Return false to make it miss.
events.LockMove: Locks the Pokémon into a move: a move id, or a function returning one.
events.MaybeTrapPokemon: Runs when the game works out whether the Pokémon might be trapped, before it knows the foe's ability.
events.ModifyAccuracy: Changes a move's accuracy against the Pokémon. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifyAtk: Changes the attacker's Attack in damage calculation. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifyBoost: Changes which stat stages count in a calculation (Unaware). Return the new boost table.
events.ModifyCritRatio: Changes a move's critical-hit stage. Return the new stage.
events.ModifyDamage: Changes a move's final damage. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifyDamagePhase1: Changes damage at the first modifier step of the generation 3 and 4 damage formula (older-generation mods).
events.ModifyDamagePhase2: Changes damage at the second modifier step of the generation 3 and 4 damage formula (older-generation mods).
events.ModifyDef: Changes the defender's Defense in damage calculation. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifyMove: Changes a move's data just before it's used. It's this use's copy, so changes don't last.
events.ModifyPriority: Changes a move's priority. Return the new priority.
events.ModifySecondaries: Changes a move's secondary effects against the Pokémon (Shield Dust): edit the list.
events.ModifySpA: Changes the attacker's Special Attack in damage calculation. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifySpD: Changes the defender's Special Defense in damage calculation. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifySpe: Changes the Pokémon's Speed. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
events.ModifySTAB: Changes a move's same-type attack bonus. Return the new multiplier.
events.ModifyTarget: Changes which Pokémon a move targets: set relayVar.target.
events.ModifyType: Changes a move's type before it's used: set move.type.
events.ModifyWeight: Changes the Pokémon's weight, in hectograms. Return the new value.
events.MoveAborted: Runs when the Pokémon's move is stopped before it's used, for example by sleep or flinching.
events.MoveFail: Runs when the move misses or fails (crash damage uses this).
events.NegateImmunity: Decides whether the Pokémon's type immunity applies. Return false, or set it to false, to ignore it.
events.OverrideAction: Replaces the move the Pokémon chose. Return the id of the move to use instead.
events.PrepareHit: Runs after a move is announced, just before it hits. Return false to make it fail.
events.PseudoWeatherChange: Runs when a pseudo-weather such as Trick Room starts.
events.RedirectTarget: Redirects a move to another Pokémon (Follow Me, Lightning Rod). Return the new target.
events.Residual: Runs at the end of each turn.
events.SetAbility: Runs before the Pokémon's ability changes. Return null to block it.
events.SetStatus: Runs before a major status is set on the Pokémon. Return false to block it.
events.SetWeather: Runs before the weather changes. Return false to block it.
events.SideConditionStart: Runs when a side condition (Tailwind, Reflect, …) starts on the Pokémon's side.
events.StallMove: Decides whether the Pokémon's Protect-like move works this turn. Return false to make it fail.
events.Swap: Runs when a Pokémon moves into a slot, for slot conditions (Healing Wish).
events.SwitchIn: Runs when the Pokémon switches in.
events.SwitchOut: Runs when the Pokémon switches out.
events.TakeItem: Runs before the Pokémon's item is taken. Return false, or set it to false, to keep it.
events.Terrain: Declared by Showdown, but this version never runs it.
events.TrapPokemon: Decides whether the Pokémon is trapped: call pokemon.tryTrap().
events.Try: Runs after the move is announced, before it tries to hit anything. Return false to make it fail.
events.TryAddVolatile: Runs before a volatile condition is added to the Pokémon. Return null to block it.
events.TryBoost: Runs before stat stage changes apply to the Pokémon: delete entries from the boost table to block them.
events.TryEatItem: Runs before the Pokémon eats a berry. Return false, or set it to false, to stop it.
events.TryHeal: Runs before the Pokémon heals. Return a new amount, or false to block it.
events.TryHit: Runs before a move hits the Pokémon. Return false to make it fail, or null to fail silently (Protect).
events.TryHitField: Runs before a move hits the field. Return false to make it fail.
events.TryHitSide: Runs before a move hits a side. Return false to make it fail.
events.TryImmunity: Decides whether the target is immune to the move. Return false for immune.
events.TryMove: Runs before the Pokémon uses a move, before it's announced. Return false to stop it (charging moves use this).
events.TryPrimaryHit: Runs before a move's main hit on the Pokémon (Substitute uses it). Return damage dealt, or false or null to stop the hit.
events.Type: Changes the Pokémon's types. Return the new list.
events.Update: Runs whenever the battle state may have changed, such as after each action (berries and status cures use it).
events.UseItem: Runs when the Pokémon is about to use its item. Return false to stop it.
events.UseMoveMessage: Runs after the move's use message, to add messages of its own.
events.Weather: Runs at the end of each turn for each active Pokémon while a weather is active (weather damage).
events.WeatherModifyDamage: Changes a move's damage for the weather. Return the new value, or nothing to keep it.
